messages:
Maya H.: quick follow-up from the postmortem: we need a single source-of-truth for all streaming reliability tasks. I started a tracking view but want to pin owners + expected dates here.
Owen L.: SGTM. I'll take the SDK detection hooks (client-side) and add a lightweight metrics export. ETA 2026-03-27.
Priya S.: I'll own the end-to-end synthetic test that runs in CI daily (simulates slow chunk delivery, chunk drops, and a mid-stream reconnect). Will push initial harness by 2026-03-25.
Theo (infra): infra will do two things: (1) make streaming reconnect logic idempotent, (2) add backpressure tuning (rate limiter tweaks). Planning a canary on 2026-03-30.
Maya H.: can we add a concrete rollback plan in the same ticket? e.g., revert to batch mode and pin model variant.
Theo (infra): yes. rollback steps in infra ticket and release job. I'll also add canary gating: stream_error_rate <= 0.3% and chunk-emit-rate variance < 10% before promoting.
Owen L.: SDK snippet I'll add to detect truncated streams:
```js
if (session.expectedTokens && session.emittedTokens < session.expectedTokens - 2) {
  metrics.increment('stream.truncated_detected')
  // attempt soft reconnect once
  client.reconnect({reason: 'truncated_stream'})
}
```
I'll include tests for both JS + Python.
Priya S.: CI harness details: two modes, chaotic (random TCP drops) and slow-chunk (delay chunks). Will wire results to the dashboard and fail the daily job if truncated_detected rate > 0.5%.
SRE-bot: Note: please ensure test runs do not exceed 30m on CI.
Maya H.: telemetry owners: Priya (CI harness logs -> dashboard), Owen (SDK metric schema), Theo (infra metrics export). Put tickets in the incidents board and link here.
Priya S.: done. Tickets: INCIDENTS-4291 (CI harness), SDK-2026 (client hooks), INFRA-3378 (reconnect/backpressure). Links posted in the retro doc.
Maya H.: timeline recap: CI harness 3/25, SDK PR 3/27, runbook update 3/26, infra canary 3/30. Weekly check-ins M/W for 3 weeks.
Theo (infra): runbook update will include emergency mitigations: force-kill session, model-pin, and traffic-shift to region fallback. I'll draft by 3/26.
Owen L.: one more: include a lightweight smoke endpoint that only streams short responses — useful for healthchecks. I'll add that to the SDK/agent health checks.
Maya H.: good call. Assigning action owners summary: Priya (CI harness + dashboard) 3/25, Owen (SDK + smoke endpoint) 3/27, Theo (infra changes + runbook) 3/26, Maya (coord + check-ins).
incident-bot: Incident #2026-0312-STREAM follow-ups recorded. Postmortem: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-0312-streaming.
Maya H.: please update the board with PR links as they land. we'll pause canary if daily harness shows regressions. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
